pre_condition: phase_fqns is a non-empty collection of function FQN strings representing functions within a single phase. callees_map is a dict mapping caller FQN strings to collections of callee FQN strings. callers_map is a dict mapping callee FQN strings to collections of caller FQN strings. Every FQN referenced uses the canonical `::` separator.
post_condition: Returns a list of layer dicts sorted by strictly increasing integer `layer` index starting from 0. Each dict contains: `layer` (non-negative integer, 0-indexed), `functions` (sorted list of FQN strings assigned to that layer), and `cycle_resolution` (boolean). Every FQN in phase_fqns appears in exactly one layer across the returned list. For any pair (caller, callee) where both FQNs belong to phase_fqns and the callee is reachable via callees_map, the callee's `layer` index is strictly less than the caller's `layer` index. `cycle_resolution` is false for a layer when every function in that layer was placed without breaking any dependency cycle among phase_fqns members. `cycle_resolution` is true for a layer when at least one function in that layer belongs to a non-trivial strongly connected component (a cycle involving two or more phase_fqns members where each member transitively depends on another in the cycle). When no cycles exist among phase_fqns members, all returned layer dicts have `cycle_resolution` set to false.
